mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and 54-degree weather near Badger Ridge Middle School, perfectly paired with the glow of a Waxing Gibbous moon.

The city is recruiting an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects by September 20. Additionally, residents can apply for a 30 dollar rebate through the Rain Barrel Program by submitting a claim form and receipt for qualifying 35-gallon barrels.
We have a busy schedule starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee, followed by more music and markets throughout the week.
In a noteworthy call from last Friday, August 15, police arrested a 44-year-old driver for operating while intoxicated, first offence, after she was found asleep in her vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. Culver's is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM to satisfy your sweet tooth.
